zh-Hans.name: FSR3 FrameGeneration
zh-Hans.summary: 生成中间帧，让 SDR 画面以固定 2× 倍率补帧。

en-US.name: FSR3 FrameGeneration
en-US.summary: Generates intermediate SDR frames at a fixed 2x multiplier.
en-US.details: Adds intermediate frames for smoother motion in games and video while keeping the image size. Start with the default AMDOF Quality setting and adjust optical-flow quality to suit processing headroom. Experimental; requires an x64 build with this feature, a supported rendering GPU, and matching runtimes. SDR and compatible effect chains only; the image must fit entirely within the output area.
